Hi Anna,

For QA Northstar Pharmacy — Coach Verification, I am preparing the German shelf-life summary for the Autumn trial. I plan to have its translation checked by 4 October 2026 and send you the summary by 5 October 2026.

Separately, for the Spring repeat order, could you confirm your provisional quantity and target delivery week? These are separate opportunities.

Please reply in this thread for the test. A provisional quantity or scheduling change is not an accepted order.

Kirill — synthetic executive
